claim: Patchline ships a neuro-symbolic model whose symbolic core is extractable and independently checkable. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the extractable claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make extractable-neuro-symbolic-gate`.
